name: Audit Trail
description: Appends one JSON line per tool call to a per-session log with sha256 hashes of the arguments and result.

name: Blast Radius Guard
description: Asks before, or blocks, destructive shell commands and writes to system paths.

name: Context Burn
description: Tracks context use per session in a status file and warns at 70% and 90% where the harness reports token use.

name: Live Guard Gate
description: Asks before live cloud mutations and names the guard agent that should review them.

name: Secret Redactor
description: Asks before tool calls whose input carries a credential and redacts credentials from tool output.
